subject: ERPNext application server is down
description: Urgent - The ERPNext application is completely inaccessible. All users are getting a 502 Bad Gateway error.
resolution: Step 1: SSH into the server and run bench status to check services. Step 2: Run sudo supervisorctl restart all to restart bench workers. Step 3: Run bench restart as the bench user. Step 4: Check nginx error log for further errors. Step 5: If still down restart the server.

subject: Outlook not syncing emails

subject: Zoom camera not working during meetings
description: Not sure if this is the right place but my camera stopped working in Zoom. Other participants cannot see me. The camera works in Windows camera app but not Zoom.

subject: Teams calls dropping frequently

subject: Cannot connect to office WiFi
description: Hi team, my laptop is not connecting to the office WiFi. It shows the network but says unable to connect. My phone connects fine.
resolution: Step 1: Forget the WiFi network and reconnect with credentials. Step 2: Restart the network adapter from Device Manager. Step 3: Flush DNS by running ipconfig /flushdns. Step 4: Contact IT to check if device MAC address needs to be registered.

subject: Suspicious login detected and account is now locked
description: I got an alert saying someone logged in from an unknown location and now I cannot log into my account at all. I need access restored urgently.
resolution: Step 1: Call IT helpdesk immediately on extension 100 for an emergency account unlock. Step 2: Verify your identity via mobile OTP. Step 3: Reset your password once unlocked. Step 4: Enable multi-factor authentication to prevent future incidents.

subject: Security alert triggered and I am locked out
description: My account was flagged for suspicious activity and automatically locked. I cannot get past the login screen. I need to get back in.
resolution: Step 1: The account lock is a security precaution. Contact IT helpdesk on extension 100 with your employee ID. Step 2: IT will verify your identity and unlock the account. Step 3: You will be prompted to change your password immediately after unlock. Step 4: Review the security alert details with IT to confirm no breach occurred.

subject: Account blocked after someone else logged in from overseas
description: A colleague told me someone used my credentials to log in from another country. Now my account shows suspended and I cannot access anything.
resolution: Step 1: Contact IT Security immediately on the emergency line — do not wait. Step 2: IT will verify whether a breach occurred and unlock your account. Step 3: Change your password and enable MFA once access is restored. Step 4: IT will review login audit logs and advise on next steps.

subject: Got a phishing warning and now cannot log in
description: I received a warning that my account may have been accessed by unauthorised person. When I try to log in now it says account suspended.
resolution: Step 1: Your account has been automatically suspended as a precaution. Contact the IT helpdesk on extension 100. Step 2: Confirm your identity and request an account reinstatement. Step 3: Change your password to something new and unique. Step 4: Report the original suspicious activity to the security team via security@company.com.

subject: Login alert says unknown device used my account now I am locked
description: I received an SMS saying a new device was used to sign in. I did not do this. My account is now locked and I need it unlocked.
resolution: Step 1: Your account was locked automatically to protect you. Contact IT helpdesk for immediate unlock. Step 2: Provide your employee ID for identity verification. Step 3: Once unlocked reset your password immediately. Step 4: Ask IT to review which device was used and revoke any unrecognised active sessions.

subject: ERP system cannot connect to the database
description: The ERP application opens but every page shows a database connection error. I can browse the internet and access emails fine. Only the ERP is affected.
resolution: Step 1: This is an application-level connection issue not a network issue. Restart the ERP application completely. Step 2: Clear the application cache if available in settings. Step 3: Check whether other users are experiencing the same issue — if widespread it may be a server-side service restart needed by IT. Step 4: Contact IT with the exact error message and the time it started.

subject: Application shows connection timeout but internet works fine
description: When I open the business application it keeps saying connection timeout or cannot reach server. However my browser works fine and I can access all websites.
resolution: Step 1: The issue is with the application configuration not the network. Try restarting the application completely. Step 2: Check if the application server address in settings is correct — it may have changed after a server migration. Step 3: Try accessing the application from a different machine to confirm whether it is device-specific. Step 4: Raise a ticket with IT including the exact error message text.

subject: Software cannot reach the backend server
description: Our accounting software keeps throwing a server unreachable error when I try to post entries. Email and internet are working normally on my machine.
resolution: Step 1: Restart the accounting application. Step 2: Check if your application needs a specific VPN or network profile to reach the backend — connect to it if not already. Step 3: Verify the server address in application settings has not changed. Step 4: Contact IT with the error code and they will check if the application server needs a restart.

subject: ERPNext database connection refused at login
description: When I try to log into ERPNext it immediately shows database connection refused. I checked and my internet connection is working fine.
resolution: Step 1: This is a server-side issue with the ERPNext application server. Check with other users to see if they are also affected. Step 2: If widespread contact the IT admin immediately as the MariaDB service may need restarting on the server. Step 3: If only affecting you try clearing browser cache and cookies and retry. Step 4: If browser fix does not help your admin account configuration may need to be reset by IT.

subject: Application crashes when trying to connect to company database
description: I installed the updated client software but it crashes every time it tries to connect to the company server. The installation completed without errors.
resolution: Step 1: This is a software compatibility issue not a network issue. Uninstall the updated client and reinstall the previous version. Step 2: Check the IT portal for known compatibility issues with the latest version. Step 3: Run the application as Administrator and check if it connects successfully. Step 4: If the issue persists raise a ticket with IT including the software version number and the crash error.

subject: Cannot log in after security team reset my account
description: The IT security team sent me a password reset email after a routine audit but when I use the temporary password it says account disabled. I cannot get in.
resolution: Step 1: Contact the IT helpdesk and reference the security audit reset — your account may have been disabled before the password reset completed. Step 2: Provide your employee ID and the reset reference number from the email. Step 3: IT will re-enable the account and confirm the new password is active. Step 4: Log in and change your password to a permanent one immediately.

subject: System flagged my account for unusual activity and blocked access
description: I have been travelling for work and now back in the office. The system says my account was flagged for unusual login locations and blocked my access.
resolution: Step 1: This is a geo-location based security policy blocking your account. Contact IT helpdesk and explain you have been travelling. Step 2: IT will verify your travel record and unblock the account. Step 3: In future notify IT in advance when travelling internationally to whitelist your locations. Step 4: Your account will be restored within 30 minutes of the call.

subject: Suspicious login notification and now I cannot get into my account
description: I received a notification that a suspicious login was detected on my account. When I tried to log in myself I found my account is now locked and I am unable to access it.
resolution: Step 1: Contact IT helpdesk on extension 100 and explain the account is locked. Step 2: IT will verify your identity and unlock the account. Step 3: Change your password immediately. Step 4: Enable MFA on your account.

subject: Account locked after suspicious access alert I need it unlocked
description: Security sent me an alert about suspicious access on my account and now it is locked. I need IT to unlock it so I can get back to work.
resolution: Step 1: Call IT helpdesk on extension 100 with your employee ID ready. Step 2: IT will authenticate you and remove the account lock. Step 3: Set a new password. Step 4: You will need to re-login to all company systems after the unlock.

subject: Someone tried to log into my account from abroad now I am blocked
description: I got an email saying an unfamiliar device logged in from a foreign country. IT blocked my account as a precaution. How do I get access restored?
resolution: Step 1: Contact IT helpdesk to restore account access. Step 2: Confirm your identity with employee number. Step 3: IT will lift the block and you can set a new password. Step 4: The login from abroad will be investigated by security separately.

subject: Received a security flag and my access is suspended I need to log in
description: My account was suspended after a security flag was raised. I have verified with my manager that I did nothing wrong. I just need my login access restored.
resolution: Step 1: Contact the IT helpdesk and reference the security flag notification. Step 2: IT will coordinate with the security team to lift the suspension. Step 3: Once cleared your access will be reinstated within one hour. Step 4: You will be asked to reset your password as part of reinstatement.

subject: Unauthorised login flagged and now my account is disabled
description: The system flagged an unauthorised login from a new location and disabled my account. I need to regain access urgently as I have deadlines today.
resolution: Step 1: This is an account access reinstatement issue. Call IT helpdesk immediately. Step 2: IT will validate your identity and re-enable the account. Step 3: Update your password to a strong unique one. Step 4: Review any changes made to your account settings after you are back in.

subject: Login blocked after security alert I need access not a security investigation
description: My account was auto-blocked after a security alert. I am not reporting a threat I just need my account unblocked so I can log in.
resolution: Step 1: Account reinstatement requests go through the IT helpdesk on extension 100. Step 2: Provide your employee ID and the alert reference number. Step 3: IT will remove the block. Step 4: You will be prompted to set a new password on first login.

subject: My password reset email says account locked for suspicious activity
description: I requested a password reset but the email I got says my account has been locked due to suspicious activity. I cannot complete the reset.
resolution: Step 1: The account lock must be removed before the password reset can complete. Call IT helpdesk. Step 2: IT will verify your identity and remove the lock. Step 3: IT will re-trigger the password reset email. Step 4: Complete the reset and log in with the new password.

subject: Account suspended due to unusual sign-in I just need to log in
description: I keep getting an error saying my account is suspended due to unusual sign-in activity. All I want is to log in to do my job. Can IT please sort this out?
resolution: Step 1: This is an account suspension — contact IT helpdesk on extension 100. Step 2: Confirm you are the legitimate account owner. Step 3: IT will lift the suspension immediately. Step 4: You will need to reset your password before the first login.

subject: Locked out of account after getting notified about login from unknown IP
description: Got a notification saying a login from an unknown IP was detected. My account was locked after that. I need it unlocked ASAP.
resolution: Step 1: Contact IT helpdesk for an account unlock. This is a precautionary lock not a permanent suspension. Step 2: Verify your identity with your employee ID. Step 3: IT will unlock within 15 minutes. Step 4: Reset your password after regaining access.

subject: Account blocked I cannot access anything since the security flag
description: Ever since the security team flagged my account I cannot access any company resource. My email is down my VPN does not work nothing. I need access back.
resolution: Step 1: This is a full account suspension from a security flag. Escalate directly to IT Security team on the emergency line. Step 2: They will verify you are the legitimate user. Step 3: All account access will be restored simultaneously once cleared. Step 4: You may need to re-enroll in MFA after reinstatement.

subject: Application cannot connect to server but my internet is working
description: The application I use for invoicing keeps showing a server connection error but I can browse the internet and use email without any issues. Only this one app is broken.
resolution: Step 1: Since other services work this is an application-specific issue not a network problem. Restart the application. Step 2: Check application settings for the server address — a recent update may have changed the configuration. Step 3: Try running the application as Administrator. Step 4: If still failing contact IT with the exact error message.

subject: ERP shows database error only in the application everything else works
description: When I open ERPNext it shows a database connection error on every page. I tested my internet connection and it is fine. Outlook and all websites work normally.
resolution: Step 1: This is an application server issue not a network issue. Try clearing your browser cache completely. Step 2: If the same error appears in incognito mode the issue is server-side. Step 3: Contact the ERP administrator — the database service on the server may need restarting. Step 4: Provide the admin with the error message and the time it started.

subject: Business application times out connecting to backend other apps work fine
description: Our accounting software times out after 30 seconds trying to connect. I checked and the company intranet and email all work fine so the network is not the issue.
resolution: Step 1: The timeout is in the application layer not the network. Restart the accounting software. Step 2: Check if the application server address in settings is correct. Step 3: Ask IT to verify the application service is running on the server side. Step 4: If the service is down IT will restart it and notify users.

subject: Software crashes with connection refused even though internet works
description: My software shows connection refused every time I launch it. I have tested the internet and it is working. Other software on the same machine connects fine.
resolution: Step 1: Connection refused usually means the application server is down or on a different port. Contact IT. Step 2: IT will check the application service status on the server. Step 3: If the service crashed IT will restart it. Step 4: Confirm with the user after restart that the application connects successfully.

subject: ERP connection timeout on all modules but network is functional
description: ERPNext is timing out on every page load. I tested by opening other websites and my network connection is completely fine. This is only happening in ERPNext.
resolution: Step 1: This is an ERPNext server-side issue. Check with the IT admin whether the application server or database service needs a restart. Step 2: Admin should check the Frappe bench log for errors using bench logs command. Step 3: If the gunicorn process has crashed restart it. Step 4: Notify all affected users once service is restored.

subject: Cannot open application says cannot reach database tried restarting network
description: My application keeps saying it cannot reach the database. I have already restarted my network adapter and the problem persists. Network looks fine.
resolution: Step 1: Since restarting the network did not help the issue is in the application or server. Contact IT application support. Step 2: IT will check the database service status on the application server. Step 3: If MariaDB or SQL Server service is stopped IT will restart it. Step 4: You will be notified when the application is back online.

subject: App showing server unreachable but colleague on same WiFi can access it
description: My application shows server unreachable error but my colleague sitting next to me using the same WiFi can access it fine. So the network is not the issue.
resolution: Step 1: Since it is device-specific on the same network this is a software issue. Restart the application and your computer. Step 2: Check if there is a local firewall or antivirus blocking the application — temporarily disable and test. Step 3: Reinstall the application client. Step 4: If reinstall does not fix it IT will check application profile settings for your account.

subject: System says database unavailable only for our department application
description: Our department application is showing database unavailable. I tested the internet, checked with IT networking — they confirmed the network is healthy.
resolution: Step 1: The network is healthy so this is an application or database service issue. Contact the application administrator directly. Step 2: Admin should check whether the database container or service for this application has stopped. Step 3: Restart the service and verify connectivity from the application server. Step 4: Test from a user machine after service restart.

subject: ERPNext login page loads but gives database connection error after submitting credentials
description: The ERPNext login page loads fine but after entering my username and password it gives a database connection error. Internet is working.
resolution: Step 1: The login page rendering fine but failing post-login indicates a database session issue. Clear browser cookies and retry. Step 2: Try a different browser. Step 3: If still failing the ERPNext database connection pool may be exhausted — contact your IT admin. Step 4: Admin should restart the bench service to release stale connections.

subject: Application keeps saying failed to connect to server I checked network it is fine
description: My project management application keeps saying failed to connect to server. I checked and my WiFi is connected and internet works. Only this app is failing.
resolution: Step 1: Since the network is confirmed working restart the application completely. Step 2: Check if there is an application update pending — a server migration may have changed the endpoint. Step 3: Contact IT with the application name and exact error message. Step 4: IT will check the application server status and update connection settings if needed.
